viewers_files_copy_copied: Tooltip of a rich view's copy button for a moment after it copied.
viewers_files_fallback_viewer_binary: Title of the card shown for a file that is not text and has no viewer.
viewers_files_fallback_viewer_binary_bod: Body of the binary file card. {size} is the file size with its unit.
viewers_files_fallback_viewer_first_byte: Caption above the hex dump of the first bytes of a binary file. {size} is the dumped size with its unit.
viewers_files_fallback_viewer_too_large: Title of the card shown for a text file over the editor's size limit.
viewers_files_fallback_viewer_too_large_: Body of the too-large card. {size} is the file size with its unit (12.4 MB), {limit} the largest size Atlas opens, in MB.
viewers_files_format_action_already_form: Toast of Format document when the file was already formatted.
viewers_files_format_action_cannot_forma: Toast of Format document when the formatter failed. {reason} is the first line of the formatter's error, in English.
viewers_files_format_action_no_formatter: Toast of Format document for a file type with no language server formatter and no built-in one.
viewers_files_format_view_copyright: Copyright line read from a LICENSE file. {year} is the year or years, {holder} the owner.
viewers_files_format_view_directory: Chip of an ignore pattern that ends with a slash: it matches folders only.
viewers_files_format_view_ignore_ignore: Chip of an ignore pattern: the matches are ignored.
viewers_files_format_view_ignore_keep: Chip of a negated ignore pattern (a line starting with !): the matches are kept.
viewers_files_format_view_ignore_tip: Tooltip of the ignore chip of an ignore pattern.
viewers_files_format_view_keep_tip: Tooltip of the keep chip of an ignore pattern that starts with !.
viewers_files_format_view_last_match_win: Note next to the CODEOWNERS Rules heading: when two patterns match a file, the later one decides.
viewers_files_format_view_no_owner: Chip of a CODEOWNERS rule that lists no owner.
viewers_files_format_view_no_processes_d: Empty state of the Procfile viewer.
viewers_files_format_view_owners_summary: Header of the CODEOWNERS viewer: how many rules and how many distinct owners the file has.
viewers_files_format_view_processes: Count of processes in the header of the Procfile viewer.
viewers_files_format_view_repo_root_only: Chip of an ignore pattern that starts with a slash: it matches only at the repository root.
viewers_files_format_view_root: Chip of an .editorconfig that sets root = true: the search for more .editorconfig files stops here.
viewers_files_format_view_rules: Heading of the rules section of the CODEOWNERS viewer.
viewers_files_format_view_rules_count: Count of patterns in the header of an ignore file viewer (.gitignore, .dockerignore).
viewers_files_format_view_sections: Count of sections in the header of the .editorconfig viewer.
viewers_files_format_view_spdx_page: Chip of the license view that opens the license on spdx.org.
viewers_files_image_viewer_actual_size: Tooltip of the zoom percentage in the image viewer: click to show the image at 100%.
viewers_files_image_viewer_copy_failed: Toast when the clipboard refused the image.
viewers_files_image_viewer_copy_image: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that copies the image to the clipboard.
viewers_files_image_viewer_fit_to_view: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that scales the image to fit the viewer.
viewers_files_load_host_too_old: Error when opening a big file on a host whose hostd cannot read a file in chunks. The host is the computer or crew server the file lives on.
viewers_files_notebook_view_cells: Count of cells in the header of the Jupyter notebook viewer.
viewers_files_notebook_view_error: Name of a notebook error output that carries no error name.
viewers_files_notebook_view_output_alt: Alternative text of an image output of a notebook cell. {n} is the cell number, starting at 1.
viewers_files_notebook_view_raw: Label in the margin of a raw cell of a Jupyter notebook (a cell type of nbformat).
viewers_files_package_view_entry_points: Heading of the section that lists the scripts of a pyproject.toml.
viewers_files_package_view_features: Heading of the section that lists the Cargo features of Cargo.toml. Cargo's own term.
viewers_files_package_view_filter_depend: Placeholder and accessible name of the dependency filter field of the package view.
viewers_files_package_view_open_name_on_: Accessible name of the button of a dependency row that opens its registry page. {name} is the dependency.
viewers_files_package_view_open_on_the_r: Tooltip of the button of a dependency row that opens its registry page.
viewers_files_package_view_registry: Chip in the header of a package manifest view that opens the package on its registry (npm, crates.io, PyPI).
viewers_files_package_view_run_in_termin: Tooltip of the Run button of a script row in the package view.
viewers_files_package_view_runs_with: Note next to the scripts heading. {pm} is the package manager that runs a script (bun, pnpm, yarn, npm, composer).
viewers_files_package_view_scripts: Heading of the section that lists the scripts of a package.json or composer.json.
viewers_files_package_view_workspaces: Heading of the section that lists the workspace members of a package or Cargo workspace.
viewers_files_pdf_rail_outline: Name of the tab of the PDF sidebar that lists the document's table of contents.
viewers_files_pdf_rail_page_n: Accessible name of a page thumbnail in the PDF sidebar. {page} is the page number.
viewers_files_pdf_rail_pages: Accessible name of the PDF sidebar and name of its thumbnails tab.
viewers_files_pdf_status_hint: Body of the PDF error card when the cause is known (password or damaged file).
viewers_files_pdf_status_invalid: Title of the PDF error card when the file cannot be parsed.
viewers_files_pdf_status_opening_pdf: Loading line of the PDF viewer.
viewers_files_pdf_status_other: Title of the PDF error card for any other failure; the reason follows in English.
viewers_files_pdf_status_password: Title of the PDF error card when the file needs a password.
viewers_files_pdf_toolbar_close_find: Accessible name of the button that closes the PDF find bar.
viewers_files_pdf_toolbar_find: Accessible name of the button that opens the PDF find bar.
viewers_files_pdf_toolbar_find_in_pdf: Placeholder of the find field of the PDF viewer.
viewers_files_pdf_toolbar_find_tip: Tooltip of the button that opens the PDF find bar. {key} is the shortcut.
viewers_files_pdf_toolbar_fit_page: Tooltip of the fit button of the PDF toolbar when it fits the width: the next click fits the whole page.
viewers_files_pdf_toolbar_fit_width: Tooltip of the zoom percentage and of the fit button of the PDF toolbar: scale the page to the viewer's width.
viewers_files_pdf_toolbar_go_to_page: Tooltip of the current page number of the PDF toolbar: click to type a page.
viewers_files_pdf_toolbar_next_match: Accessible name of the next match button of the PDF find bar.
viewers_files_pdf_toolbar_pages_outline: Tooltip of the button that shows or hides the page thumbnails and the outline of the PDF.
viewers_files_pdf_toolbar_pdf_controls: Accessible name of the floating toolbar of the PDF viewer.
viewers_files_pdf_toolbar_previous_match: Accessible name of the previous match button of the PDF find bar.
viewers_files_pdf_toolbar_toggle_fit: Accessible name of the fit button of the PDF toolbar, which switches between fit width and fit page.
viewers_files_pdf_toolbar_toggle_sidebar: Accessible name of the button that shows or hides the PDF thumbnails sidebar.
viewers_files_rich_view_render_anyway: Button of the big file warning: show the rich view despite the size.
viewers_files_rich_view_too_large: Warning of the rich (eye) view for a big file. {size} is the file size with its unit.
viewers_files_table_view_cell: Chip of the selected cell in the footer of the table viewer. R is short for row (L for linha); {row} starts at 1 and {column} is the column name.
viewers_files_table_view_columns: Column count in the header of the table viewer.
viewers_files_table_view_copy_cell: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that copies the selected table cell.
viewers_files_table_view_copy_row: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that copies the selected table row.
viewers_files_table_view_delimiter_comma: Chip that names the column delimiter of a table file: the comma.
viewers_files_table_view_delimiter_pipe: Chip that names the column delimiter of a table file: the | character.
viewers_files_table_view_delimiter_semic: Chip that names the column delimiter of a table file: the semicolon.

viewers_files_table_view_delimiter_tab.description: Chip that names the column delimiter of a table file: the tab character.
viewers_files_table_view_delimiter_tab.distinct: names the tab character used as a delimiter, not the Tab key

viewers_files_table_view_empty_file: Empty state of the table viewer when the file has no rows.
viewers_files_table_view_filter_rows: Placeholder and accessible name of the row filter of the table viewer.
viewers_files_table_view_no_header: Chip of the table viewer when the first row does not look like column names.
viewers_files_table_view_no_rows_match: Empty state of the table viewer when the filter matches no row.
viewers_files_table_view_ragged: Warning chip of the table viewer: rows whose number of columns differs from the others.
viewers_files_table_view_rows: Row count in the header of the CSV and TSV table viewer. Joined with the column count by a dot.
viewers_files_table_view_rows_filtered: Row count in the header of the table viewer while a filter is active. {count} is how many rows match, {total} how many the file has; the plural follows {total}.
viewers_files_table_view_sort_by: Tooltip of a column header of the table viewer. {column} is the column name.
viewers_files_tree_view_cannot_parse: Banner of the JSON, YAML and TOML tree viewer when the file has a syntax error. {format} is the file type name, {error} the parser's reason, in English.
viewers_files_tree_view_collapse_all: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that closes every node of the tree viewer.
viewers_files_tree_view_copy_path: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that copies the path of a node (a.b[0].c).
viewers_files_tree_view_expand_all: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that opens every node of the tree viewer.
viewers_files_tree_view_matches: Chip of the tree viewer while a search is active: how many keys or values match.
viewers_files_tree_view_nothing_matches: Empty state of the tree viewer when the search matches nothing.
viewers_files_tree_view_search_keys_and_: Placeholder of the search field of the tree viewer.
viewers_files_tree_view_visible: Header of the tree viewer: file type name and how many nodes are visible now. {format} is the file type name.
viewers_files_tsconfig_view_base_first: Note next to the extends chain heading: the files are listed from the base to the file itself.
viewers_files_tsconfig_view_compiler_opt: Heading of the section that lists the effective compiler options of a tsconfig.
viewers_files_tsconfig_view_extends_chai: Heading of the section that lists the tsconfig files that extend each other. extends is the tsconfig key.
viewers_files_tsconfig_view_filter_optio: Placeholder and accessible name of the option filter of the tsconfig viewer.
viewers_files_tsconfig_view_from: Note on a compiler option inherited from another file. {path} is that file's last two path segments.
viewers_files_tsconfig_view_layer_option: Note on a link of the extends chain: how many compiler options that file sets.
viewers_files_tsconfig_view_not_found: Note on a link of the extends chain whose file could not be read.
viewers_files_tsconfig_view_options: Count of compiler options in the header of the tsconfig viewer, after merging the extends chain.
viewers_files_tsconfig_view_scope: Heading of the section that lists the include, exclude, files and references of a tsconfig.
viewers_files_tsconfig_view_this_file: Note on the last link of the extends chain: the tsconfig being viewed.
viewers_files_viewer_actions_open_extern: Button of a viewer that has no preview, and tooltip of the PDF toolbar: opens the file in the system's default app.
viewers_files_workflow_reusable: Runs-on column of a GitHub Actions job that calls a reusable workflow instead of running on a runner.
viewers_files_workflow_step_n: Name of a GitHub Actions step that has no name, no uses and no run. {n} starts at 1.
viewers_files_zoom_in: Tooltip and accessible name of the zoom in button of the image and PDF viewers.
viewers_files_zoom_out: Tooltip and accessible name of the zoom out button of the image and PDF viewers.
